scope: FreeCAD main source and native headless macOS ARM64 SOLID controls, original and patched
findings: The pinned 1.1.4 CDxfRead source has no SOLID or 3DFACE dispatcher; its native no-shape results were recorded separately.

At current main, CDxfRead::ReadEntity dispatches SOLID to ReadSolid and ImpExpDxfRead::OnReadSolid constructs the face with DXF corner order 1-2-4-3. There is no corresponding 3DFACE dispatch; generic-shape comments are not a reader route.

Native confirmation: current-main SOLID with negative-axis or oblique extrusion is created at raw OCS vertices; default-axis SOLID and following LINE remain intact. The unmerged patch applies the normalized arbitrary-axis basis to SOLID corners.

The shared OCS basis used signed X/Y comparisons and omitted X-axis normalization; the patch uses absolute threshold comparisons and normalizes the selected axis. Native SOLID controls exercise normals (-1,0,0), (0.6,0,0.8), and non-unit (3,0,4); other OCS consumers still require independent qualification.
next: Integrate and review the downstream SOLID OCS patch; qualify GUI open/insert and native Linux/Windows, additional signed/threshold/invalid normals, thickness, and other shared-basis consumers.

Implement WCS 3DFACE dispatch with triangular/planar quad handling and explicit disposition of nonplanar faces and group-70 edge visibility; test supported shapes and failure reporting, open/insert and nested blocks.
Keep FreeCAD 1.1.4 and development-source results distinct.
limits: Native checks use a headless macOS ARM64 build of the exact source archive with the local patch; the archive lacks Git metadata and the binary reports its revision as Unknown.
No GUI open/insert, Linux/Windows, producer-authored sample, thickness, invalid normal, arbitrary nested transforms, or other OCS consumer has been qualified.
No new format-support claims or phase-gate promotion.
